class Animal {
    final String name;

    Animal({
        required this.name,
    });

    factory Animal.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return Animal(
            name: json["name"] as String,
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "name": name,
        };
    }
}

class Dog {
    final String name;
    final String breed;

    Dog({
        required this.name,
        required this.breed,
    });

    factory Dog.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
        return Dog(
            name: json["name"] as String,
            breed: json["breed"] as String,
        );
    }

    Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
        return {
            "name": name,
            "breed": breed,
        };
    }
}
